method: Take the 61 shared BHCMIS organization identifiers from the Ohio HPSA identifier crosswalk and summarize all Ohio service-site rows under those organizations. This is organization/site context, not a claim that every site is the HPSA-designated service location.
interpretation: The site file supplies a nominal operating-hours field for most site rows and a known schedule for a minority. It does not supply appointment availability, new-patient acceptance, insurance acceptance, wait, price, actual use, or outcome. Organization-level hours cannot be assigned to a particular HPSA component or resident.
next_test: Resolve the shared organization/site identity at the component level, then obtain or document patient acceptance, insurance, appointment wait, service type, and travel-cost fields for a defined population.
storage_boundary: Only compact counts are retained; the temporary site CSV remains outside the repository.
